name: pickup_respawn_spawn_def
description: Pickup::RespawnSpawnDef reactivates a pickup spawn node, restores pickup flags/name/transform state, and starts the model-reference fade-in task.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.

The native smoke verifies these node, object-data, recursive child, and model-ref task effects.
